name: reallydone
description: ReallyDone: proof that an AI's change is really done. Any agent's change in, ready / not ready out, with proof.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run bundle
scripts.build: npm run build -w reallydone-engine && npm run build -w reallydone-cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w reallydone-engine -w reallydone-cli
